text: I'm surprised you didn't make the larger point: this is true for every product Microsoft has ever made. Copy, improve, persist. Basic, DOS, Windows, Office, IE, etc. They are not a creative company (or as Jobs would have it they have no taste - [VIDEO] ). Their business does not revolve around creating new things but about copying and improving things that already exist in the market. And to be fair, this strategy has worked out quite well for them so far, so why would they change course?

text: It was 1996 ( [VIDEO] ). No, Jobs was certainly never as humble as Musk and I never said that, they definitely have different characters.
